name: Soft Leather Jack
description: A supple leather jack offering modest protection while allowing freedom of movement, favored by common soldiers.

name: Soft Leather Jerkin
description: A rugged leather jerkin, worn tight to the body for stealth and ease of travel.

name: Soft Leather Leggings
description: Flexible leather leggings that shield the legs without hindering swift movement.

name: Soft Leather Skullcap
description: A simple padded leather skullcap providing minor protection against glancing blows.

name: Boiled Leather Breastplate
description: A hardened leather breastplate, stiffened by boiling, offering sturdier defense than its softer kin.

name: Mail Chausses
description: Heavy mail leggings designed to protect the lower body from brutal slashes and stabs.

name: Mail Coat
description: A long coat of interlocking mail links that offers full protection while weighing down its wearer.

name: Mail Coif
description: A hood of fine mail that guards the head and neck from blades and arrows.

name: Mail Shirt
description: A sturdy shirt of riveted mail, balancing protection and mobility for adventurers and soldiers.

name: Breastplate
description: A gleaming steel breastplate that shields the chest from deadly strikes, favored by knights and captains.

name: Open Plate Helmet
description: A steel helm with an open face, balancing vision with formidable head protection.

name: Plate Bracers
description: Forged steel bracers protecting the forearms, gleaming with the mark of the armorer’s craft.

name: Plate Helm
description: A full steel helm enclosing the head completely, offering supreme protection at the cost of comfort.
